name: Salad
steps: Wash the cucumber, tomatoes and coriander under clean running water and dry them. Trim the cucumber ends and remove the tomatoes’ tough stem sections.
Cut cucumber and tomato into similar bite-size pieces so each spoonful is balanced. Finely chop the coriander and remove any seeds from the lemon juice.
Place the vegetables in a wide bowl and mix gently with the coriander. If preparing ahead, keep this undressed mixture covered and refrigerated.
Just before serving, add the lemon juice and salt. Toss gently from the bottom, taste, and serve promptly so the vegetables retain their crispness.
tips: Dress just before serving to keep the salad crisp.
substitutions: Any substitution changes the recipe: recheck allergies, Jain rules and quantities.
notes: Prices are sample ingredient-cost assumptions. Replace with supplier rates before procurement.
